name: Sinuous
description: Two waves to a cell instead of one, so the line runs twice as fast.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 50 C12 8 26 92 50 50 C74 8 88 92 100 50; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 50 C12 8 26 92 50 50 C74 8 88 92 100 50; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
